# Spine — prose diagnostics

## Central claim

The prose diagnostics report numbers over the drafted text, never verdicts.

## Rungs

### R1 — abstract

- establishes: the diagnostics report numbers over the drafted text
- restates: R3

### R2 — introduction

- establishes: a number read as a target stops being a measurement
- opens: D1 (closed by R3) — whether a reported number can be trusted

### R3 — results

- establishes: the reported numbers leave the exit code alone
- closes: D1
